cases.sentence: Горе издающим несправедливые ___ и пишущим жестокие постановления.
cases.translation: Woe to those who decree unjust decrees and write oppressive statutes.
cases.explain: законы is the direct object of издающим (decreeing), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Горе Ассирии, жезлу моего негодования! Я посылаю ее против безбожного ___.
cases.translation: Woe to Assyria! I send it against an ungodly kingdom.
cases.explain: царства follows against an implied comparison, requiring genitive.

cases.sentence: Я отправляю ее против ___, на который гневаюсь.
cases.translation: I direct it against a people who provoke my anger.
cases.explain: народа follows the preposition против (against), which requires genitive case.

cases.sentence: Тот ___ остаток Израиля, уцелевшие из дома Иакова, не станут полагаться на того, кто разил их.
cases.translation: In that day the remnant of Israel will not rely on the one who struck them.
cases.explain: день is a time expression with в (in), requiring accusative case.

cases.translation: The remnant will return to the mighty God.
cases.explain: Богу follows к (to), which requires the dative case.

cases.translation: But the Lord raised up enemies against them.
cases.explain: врагов is the direct object of воздвиг (raised), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я стер границы народов, захватил их запасы на всей ___.
cases.translation: I removed the boundaries of nations and captured their treasures throughout the land.
cases.explain: земле follows на (on), which requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Свет Израиля встанет огнем, святой его пламенем, которое в один день сожжет и пожрет терновник ее и колючки, и уничтожит славу его ___.
cases.translation: The light of Israel will become fire, consuming briars and thorns and destroying the glory of its forests.
cases.explain: лесов follows уничтожит (will destroy), requiring genitive case.

reading.ru: Горе издающим несправедливые законы и пишущим жестокие постановления, чтобы лишать бедняков их прав.
reading.question: Who is warned in this passage?
options: Those who decree unjust laws and rob the poor
reading.correct: Those who decree unjust laws and rob the poor
reading.explain: The passage warns against those making unjust laws and depriving the poor.

reading.ru: Я посылаю ее против безбожного народа.
reading.question: What is Assyria sent to do?
reading.explain: God says he sends Assyria against an ungodly nation.

reading.ru: «Не все ли цари мои вельможи?» — говорит он.
reading.question: What is the king of Assyria claiming?
reading.explain: The king boasts about his princes and their status.

reading.ru: Остаток вернется, остаток Иакова вернется к могучему Богу.
reading.question: What will the remnant of Israel do?
reading.explain: The text states the remnant will return to God.

reading.ru: Мой народ, живущий на Сионе, не бойся ассирийцев, которые бьют тебя палкой.
reading.question: Who is told not to fear?
reading.explain: God's people in Zion are encouraged not to fear.

reading.ru: Очень скоро мое негодование на тебя пройдет, и мой гнев обратится им на погибель.
reading.question: What will happen soon?
options: God's wrath against Israel will pass and turn against Assyrians
reading.correct: God's wrath against Israel will pass and turn against Assyrians
reading.explain: God's anger against Israel will end and turn against the Assyrians.
